summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no code changes made — investigation only)  **What I found by tracing the code (not yet verified live):**  The backend already does the right thing. `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` scopes every watchlist by `user_id`, and `handlers.ts` (lines 12–21) has its own auth check that reads the `arca_session` cookie, resolves the user, and does `c.req.raw.headers.set("X-User-Id", user.id)` before every route. All reads/writes filter `WHERE user_id = ?`. So data is not actually vanishing server-side — a user's cards stay attached to their account cookie session.  The bug I can
